title: 1 Samuel Bible Quiz - Chapter 28
description: Ten questions on 1 Samuel 28: Saul's fear before the Philistines and his visit to the woman at Endor.

questions.text: What did Achish say he would make David?
questions.explanation: Achish said to David, "Therefore I will make you my bodyguard forever."

questions.text: Whom had Saul sent away out of the land?
questions.explanation: Saul had sent away those who had familiar spirits and the wizards out of the land.

answers.text: The priests of Nob and their families
Those with familiar spirits and the wizards
The prophets who lived at Ramah

questions.text: Where did Saul and all Israel encamp?
questions.explanation: The Philistines encamped in Shunem, and Saul gathered all Israel together, and they encamped in Gilboa.

questions.text: In which ways did Yahweh not answer Saul?
questions.explanation: When Saul inquired of Yahweh, Yahweh didn't answer him by dreams, by Urim, or by prophets.

answers.text: By dreams, by Urim, or by prophets
By fire, by wind, or by earthquake
By angels, by signs, or by a voice
By lots, by visions, or by priests

questions.text: Where did Saul's servants say a woman with a familiar spirit lived?
questions.explanation: His servants said, "Behold, there is a woman who has a familiar spirit at Endor."

questions.text: How did Saul go to the woman?
questions.explanation: Saul disguised himself and put on other clothing and went with two men, and they came to the woman by night.

answers.text: In his royal robes, at noon
With his whole army, by day
Disguised, with two men, by night

questions.text: Whom did Saul ask the woman to bring up?
questions.explanation: The woman asked whom she should bring up, and Saul said, "Bring Samuel up for me."

questions.text: How did the woman describe the one coming up?
questions.explanation: The woman said, "An old man comes up. He is covered with a robe."

answers.text: A young man holding a sword
An old man covered with a robe

questions.text: According to Samuel, why had Yahweh done this to Saul?
questions.explanation: Samuel said it was because Saul didn't obey Yahweh's voice and didn't execute his fierce wrath on Amalek.

answers.text: He built an altar at Gilgal
He didn't execute Yahweh's wrath on Amalek

questions.text: What did the woman kill and prepare for Saul?
questions.explanation: The woman had a fattened calf in the house; she killed it and baked unleavened bread.
